wikipediaSummary.title: Rapture (Anita Baker album)
wikipediaSummary.description: 1986 studio album by American singer Anita Baker
wikipediaSummary.extract: Rapture is the second album by American vocalist Anita Baker, released in 1986. This became Baker's breakout album and earning her two Grammy Awards. The album's first track, "Sweet Love", was a top 10 Billboard hit in addition to winning a Grammy Award. The album has sold over eight million copies worldwide, including five million in the US alone.
